title: Personalslo Metric4 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalslo:metric4
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often personalslo metric4 (4) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on personalslo metric4 (4) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly how often your personalslo metric4 (4) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
